chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"When we wish to perform cupping during the month of Ramadan, we do it at night."

key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the period of obligatory fasting

ai.seo_question: When should cupping be done during Ramadan according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that when cupping was intended during the month of Ramadan, it was done at night. It indicates a practical ruling related to fasting etiquette and avoiding cupping during the daytime of Ramadan.
